@graph.description: What does a robotic palletizer cost? See list prices, price drivers and how payback is estimated, then calculate your ROI. Talk with our Sales Engineer.

mainEntity.name: Does a Robotic Palletizer List Price Include Installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. TRF list prices for the TRFCobot Dual, TRFCompact Dual and TRFSpeed 100 are EX Works Lenexa, Kansas, installation not included. Installation, line integration, the gripper, the conveyor interface and options are quoted with your application, because line speed, case weight, pallet pattern and layout change the scope. Compare installed cost when you evaluate offers.

mainEntity.name: What Is the Difference in Cost Between a Cobot Palletizer and a Full Industrial Robotic Cell?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cobot palletizer is the lower-entry-cost path, designed for lower speed, lighter cases and high-mix lines. An industrial robot cell costs more and delivers more speed, payload and duty cycle. At TRF, the TRFCobot Dual lists at US$ 120,000 and the TRFCompact Dual, a compact industrial cell, at US$ 180,000, both before installation.

mainEntity.name: How Much Does a Freezer Palletizer Cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A palletizer for areas below 32°F is engineered for the cold environment, so it is quoted per application. TRFSubzero, the TRF palletizer for frozen food, ice cream and frozen meat in below-freezing areas, has no published list price. Send your products, rates, pallet patterns and area temperature, and a TRF Sales Engineer prepares a quote for your line.

mainEntity.name: What Is the Typical Payback Period for a Robotic Palletizer?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no single typical figure. Payback depends on the labor hours the palletizer replaces, shifts per day, local labor cost and the installed cost of the system, so a line with more shifts and more operators on palletizing recovers the investment sooner. Run the palletizing ROI calculator with your own data for an initial estimate.

mainEntity.name: Can a Compact Palletizer Be Installed in a Brownfield Plant With Limited Space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. TRFCompact was designed for brownfield plants where floor space is a major limitation, with an industrial robot in a compact, standardized cell. TRFCobot fits small footprints where a traditional robotic cell is hard to install. Layout, reach and pallet flow are confirmed for each installation, and adapting an existing plant can add integration cost.

mainEntity.name: What Maintenance Does a Robotic Palletizer Require to Avoid Downtime?

acceptedAnswer.text: A robotic palletizer needs periodic inspection of the gripper, sensors and robot, following the manufacturer's schedule, plus spare wear parts on hand. For TRF-supplied equipment, Parts and Service covers technical support, spare parts kept in the United States and the TRFCare preventive maintenance program, which belong in your total cost of ownership.
